description: Werify gives users their own WhatsApp archive inside ChatGPT — conversations they imported from a chat export or captured from a number they connected. They can find a conversation, read its transcript a page at a time (voice notes included, as text), search inside it and list its attachments. With the user's approval it can also act: send one confirmed text message, connect a WhatsApp number by pairing code, preview how far back a chat's earlier history reaches and how much of it each window would bring in, start or stop capture, and bring in one window the user explicitly approved. Werify is prepaid and the account is funded on werify.app; nothing is sold, priced or paid for through this app.
